pages.title: Theoretical Notes II
pages.text: The middle volume of my theory: superintelligent cores, M-branes, compactified dimensions curled small, armour plates of degenerate matter, the slag left when spacetime is overworked. It reads like a manual for an engineer working on the universe from the outside.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Putting the second theoretical volume together meant compressing string theory and stellar engineering onto the same pages - an M-brane and a compactified circle bound with degenerate armour plate, spacetime slag and cosmic neutronium.
